description: We are Team FireWatch, working on a Satellite-Based Forest Fire Hotspot Monitoring System. Our goal is to use NASA satellite data to identify and monitor forest fire hotspots and support early awareness. We are interested in AI, Data Science, Python, and Web Development. We welcome passionate team members with skills in Python, data analysis, satellite data, web development, UI/UX design, and presentation.
summary: FireWatch is a satellite-based fire hotspot monitoring system designed to help identify and monitor potential fire activity across India, with a special focus on Tamil Nadu. The platform uses NASA FIRMS satellite data to display hotspot observations on an interactive map. It provides hotspot counts, detection confidence levels, date-based filtering, regional filtering, searchable records, and downloadable CSV reports. Marker clustering helps users explore large numbers of hotspot observations more efficiently. FireWatch aims to make satellite hotspot information easier to understand and access, supporting environmental monitoring and early awareness of potential fire events. These observations require verification and do not represent confirmed fires.
details: FireWatch – Satellite-Based Fire Hotspot Monitoring System FireWatch is a web-based application designed to monitor satellite-detected fire hotspots using NASA FIRMS (Fire Information for Resource Management System) data. The application retrieves satellite hotspot observations and displays their locations on an interactive map. Users can explore observations across India and Tamil Nadu, filter them by date and detection confidence, search observation details, and view information such as latitude, longitude, acquisition date, time, and satellite source. The application also provides summary counts and allows users to download filtered observations as CSV reports. FireWatch helps users understand the geographical distribution of satellite-detected hotspots and makes fire-related information easier to explore. Its intended impact is to improve public awareness, support environmental monitoring, and help users identify areas that may need further investigation. The project was developed using Python, Flask, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. The interactive map uses Leaflet and MarkerCluster, while NASA FIRMS provides satellite hotspot data. The application was developed and tested using PyCharm. The creative aspect of FireWatch is its integration of NASA satellite observations with an easy-to-use web interface. Features such as interactive hotspot clustering, confidence-based filtering, regional selection, and downloadable reports make large amounts of satellite data easier to understand. Our team considered data accessibility, usability, map performance, geographical filtering, and the importance of presenting satellite observations responsibly. We also considered that a satellite hotspot detection does not necessarily represent a confirmed fire. FireWatch is designed as a monitoring and awareness tool, not as an automatic fire-confirmation or prediction system.
